jobs.title: Environmental Scientist/Industrial Hygiene Technician
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Profit sharing
* Vision insurance
* 401(k) matching
* Bonus based on performance
* Competitive salary
* Dental insurance
**Benefits/Perks**
* Flexible Scheduling
* Competitive Compensation
* 401K
* Career Advancement Opportunities
* Health, Dental, Vision Insurance

**Job Summary**
Provides support for a wide range of environmental projects with a focus on hazardous material and indoor air quality testing (asbestos, lead\-based paint, mold, etc.).  


**Company Info \& Job Responsibilities**
Guzi\-West Inspection and Consulting, LLC is seeking qualified candidates to add a member to our Northern California team. A candidate who will succeed in this position is a self starter, with great organization and stellar written and verbal communication skills. Work would include completing hazardous material surveys including testing for asbestos, lead, mold and more, project management, operation of technical equipment, report writing, and much more. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing firm where we truly value every employee. Opportunities to work with GIS applications and in the lab are also available. Health, dental, and vision coverages is offered. All home office equipment (laptop, printer, etc.) will be provided to you.  

  

Minimum Requirements (may be waived with alternative achievements):  

* AA/AS in Environmental Science OR 2\+ Years’ Experience in Construction, Restoration, Inspections/Consulting, or a Related Field


* Understanding of building systems


* Self\-starter with a strong attention and excellent organization skills, capable of working in a fast paced environment


* Have a valid driver’s license, reliable transportation, a clean driving record, and willingness to work overtime and travel as projects require


* Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)


* Capable of following safe work practices and company guidelines while climbing ladders, performing site surveys and wearing PPE (Tyvek, respiratory protection), and lifting equipment (\<30lbs).


* Basic map drafting skills



The most competitive applicant may also have some or all the following:  

* Experience in the environmental consulting sector


* Experience working with hazardous materials (asbestos, lead, mold, radon, etc.)


* Have any of the following certifications: (CAC/CSST, CDPH Lead PM or I/A, Asbestos Building Inspector or Contractor Supervisor)


* 4\-Year Bachelor of Science / Degree in Industrial Hygiene (or related).


* Experience preforming mold investigations and home inspections


* Strong technical skills (computer use, report writing, map making, regulatory knowledge, etc.)


* Experience growing a team and handling client relationships



Example of potential day\-to\-day responsibilities:  

* Project management \& hazardous material field surveys


* Running air sampling equipment, taking material samples, microscope analysis


* Managing client relationships \& providing technical guidance on regulatory or environmental subjects


* Commuting to jobsites and transferring equipment


* Job scheduling and other administrative tasks


* Report writing and/or briefing clients on survey results


* Research and training

  


Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Mid-level Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **AECOM's** **Environment, Health \& Safety team** is seeking an experienced **Mid\-level Environmental Scientist III** to join our team and support and manage environmental compliance programs for public\- and/or private\-sector clients. This mid\-level role is ideal for a candidate with a solid regulatory foundation who can work independently on routine compliance tasks while supporting more complex projects under senior staff guidance. The successful candidate will contribute to technical delivery, client support, and internal collaboration within a consulting\-oriented environment.

**This hybrid position will be based out of our San Jose, CA office.**

**Key Responsibilities include:**

* Environmental Compliance Support.
* Support implementation of environmental compliance programs related to federal, state, and local regulations (e.g., Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act, RCRA, TSCA, EPCRA, and state equivalents).
* Conduct regulatory applicability evaluations, document reviews, and compliance assessments.
* Assist with preparation of permit applications, compliance plans, reports, and regulatory correspondence.
* Support environmental audits and follow\-up corrective actions under direction of senior staff.
* Track regulatory changes and assist with compliance strategy updates.
* Project support \& client interaction.
* Provide day\-to\-day technical support for environmental compliance projects.
* Coordinate with project managers and multidisciplinary teams to meet scope, schedule, and quality requirements.
* Participate in client meetings and site visits as needed.
* Prepare clear, well\-organized technical deliverables and summaries for client review.
* Data Management \& Documentation
* Compile, manage, and analyze environmental compliance data.
* Support development and maintenance of compliance tracking tools and documentation systems.
* Ensure project files and records meet internal quality and compliance standards.

**About AECOM’s Environment Business Line**  

Join AECOM to be part of an expert global team who is connected through a well\-developed, worldwide, internal technical practice network through which you can learn from and brainstorm with the best in the world. AECOM is an industry\-leading, world class environmental firm, and we want you to succeed within it. We respect and encourage your own pathway to excellence via our Freedom to Grow initiative.  

  

AECOM is known for our award\-winning technical excellence, leading\-edge science and innovative project delivery. We provide sustainable solutions for some of the world’s most challenging issues. Our global clients and their projects span a variety of market sectors and geographies and require innovative technical solutions to solve wide\-ranging environmental problems.

 **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, chemistry, or a related field.
* 4 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education focusing on environmental compliance within consulting, industry, or a regulatory agency with strong knowledge of key environmental regulations and compliance frameworks.
* Due to the nature of the work, US Citizenship is required.
* Valid Driver's license and motor vehicle records check is required for this role.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or professional certification (e.g., CHMM, CEA) is a plus.
* 6\+ years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education focusing on environmental compliance within consulting, industry, or a regulatory agency with strong knowledge of key environmental regulations and compliance frameworks.
* Experience preparing technical reports and supporting environmental permitting or compliance activities.
* Prior experience working in an environmental consulting firm is highly desired.
* Familiarity with state environmental programs and agency interactions.
* Experience with compliance auditing, inspections, or regulatory inspections.
* Proficiency with compliance tracking tools, spreadsheets, or data management systems.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a project\-based environment.

  

**Additional Information**  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition

jobs.title: Senior Hydrogeologist
jobs.description:
Description: ***You’ll Come for a Job…But You’ll Stay for an Exciting Career!******Engineering and Designing Reliable, Responsive, Solutions.*** **SINCE 1976,** **CANNON** has provided creative solutions to clients in the energy industry, water resources, public infrastructure, and commercial and residential development. We work hard. We play hard. We have fun.

**JOIN CANNON** as a **Senior Hydrogeologist** in **Ventura.** Ventura lies 30 miles south of Santa Barbara, located between the foothills of the Los Padres National Forest and the scenic Pacific Ocean. Boasting miles of beaches and scenic parks, its Mediterranean climate provides abundant year\-round recreational and cultural opportunities.

  



**SENIOR HYDROGEOLOGIST JOB SUMMARY**


The Senior Hydrogeologist is responsible for managing hydrogeology projects and independently performing groundwater investigations, analyses, and technical assignments. This position applies advanced hydrogeologic knowledge to groundwater supply planning, well siting and development, aquifer testing, water quality evaluations, and related water resources projects.


The Senior Hydrogeologist manages projects from work planning through reporting and implementation support, develops and reviews technical analyses, coordinates with clients and regulatory agencies, and provides technical direction to less\-experienced staff. This position also supports business development activities through client relationship development, preparation of scopes and fees, and participation in professional and community activities.

**SENIOR HYDROGEOLOGIST JOB DUTIES**

* Manages hydrogeology and groundwater projects from planning through reporting and implementation, ensuring work is completed on schedule and within budget.
* Performs and oversees hydrogeologic investigations, analyses, and field programs related to groundwater supply, wells, aquifer testing, water quality, and basin management.
* Analyzes hydrogeologic data and develop technical conclusions, recommendations, reports, figures, maps, and other project deliverables.
* Develops and reviews conceptual groundwater models and supports groundwater modeling and water supply evaluations.
* Coordinates with clients, regulatory agencies, engineers, drillers, laboratories, GIS professionals, and other project team members.
* Prepares project scopes, schedules, budgets, fee estimates, and technical components of proposals.
* Provides technical direction and reviews the work of less experienced hydrogeologists, field staff, GIS analysts, and technicians.
* Builds and maintains client relationships and supports business development and professional networking activities.


Requirements:  



* Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Hydrogeology, Earth Science, Geological Engineering, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
* 10\+ years of progressively responsible hydrogeology experience, including independent technical assignments.
* Professional Geologist (PG) license required; Certified Hydrogeologist (CHG) or Engineering Geologist certification desirable.
* Strong knowledge of groundwater supply, well construction, water quality, permitting, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Proficiency with GIS, aquifer test analysis, groundwater databases, technical spreadsheets, and water supply evaluation tools; working knowledge of groundwater modeling concepts and MODFLOW\-based platforms.
* Demonstrated project management skills, including developing scopes, budgets, schedules, and coordinating multidisciplinary project teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate with clients, agencies, and technical teams.

**WE OFFER** competitive salaries, excellent benefits package, remote work flexibility, and an active and positive team building, work environment.

*Cannon is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to status as a protected veteran or a qualified individual with a disability, or other protected status such as race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age.*

jobs.title: Geotechnical Field Technician (Santa Barbara)
jobs.description:
**Earth Systems: Your Trusted Partner in Geotechnical Excellence**


With a rich history of providing a full spectrum of geotechnical, geology, environmental consulting, materials testing, and special inspection services since 1969, Earth Systems is deeply rooted within our communities. Our foundation is our people. We embrace our diverse staff of highly skilled professionals who have a wide range of backgrounds, experience, and talents. At each of our 10 offices throughout California, we foster a collaborative teamwork environment and empower our team with the freedom to steer their projects and career paths.

*“If you want to better your situation, join Earth Systems. The company that cares. I love my job and the people are amazing!” – Manny, Field Technician*


Step into a position where your passion and expertise can thrive and see why our average employee tenure is over 11 years!


Earth Systems is seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Geotechnical Field Technician for our Santa Barbara operations. The ideal candidate will assist in field investigations, data collection, and sample analysis to support geotechnical engineering projects.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* B.S. in Geology, Civil Engineering, or Environmental Science preferred, but not required
* ACI certifications: Aggregate Testing Technician, Aggregate/Soils Base Testing Technician, Concrete Strength Testing Technician, Concrete\-Field Testing Technician
* NICET: Construction Materials Testing: Asphalt, Concrete, Soils.
* Caltrans: JTCP Soils and Aggregate; JTCP HMA I \& II.
* Nuclear gauge certification
* DSA and AWS CWI certifications are a plus.
* Prior experience in geotechnical fieldwork or related construction experience is preferred.
* Must be familiar with Microsoft programs.
* Math, analytical, and writing skills are required and must be willing to “learn by doing.”
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* A good work ethic, attention to detail, and a high level of personal integrity.
* Must have reliable transportation and a clean driving record

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Fieldwork related to soils engineering and construction, including compaction testing of soils, aggregates, and asphalt
* Observation of grading activities and foundation construction, identification and sampling of construction materials, and special inspection of concrete, masonry, and steel
* Record field data and prepare daily field reports and formal reports in accordance with Earth Systems’ report protocols and procedures.
* Collaborate with engineers, geologists, and project managers to ensure project specifications are met.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards.
* Operate and maintain field testing equipment, perform troubleshooting, and maintain calibration of equipment.
* Demonstrate the company's safety behaviors by following safety protocols and promoting a safety culture among team members.
* Perform other related duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Availability to commute/relocate:**

* Reliably commute or plan to relocate prior to starting work (Required)

**What we offer**:

* Competitive salary
* Bundled Medical/Vision/Dental Plan options (including a 100% Employer Paid plan option \& up to 50% dependent paid)
* Employer sponsored life and AD\&D coverage
* Employer sponsored long\-term disability insurance
* Generous PTO
* Paid holidays
* Employee Assistance Program
* 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Health Savings Account
* Certification/continuing education reimbursement


Join us at Earth Systems and be a part of a team that values excellence in geotechnical engineering!


The expected pay range for this position is $25\.00\-38\.00\. Exact rate is dependent on several factors such as experience, skills, education/certifications, and geographic location.

*Employment conditioned upon the satisfactory completion of a background check, review of Motor Vehicle Records, drug screening, and a medical evaluation appropriate to the position.*

*Earth Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer under Section 503 and VEVRAA.*

*Earth Systems provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

jobs.title: Field Technician
jobs.description:
**WHAT WE DO**


**As a premier provider of environmental services in the Western United States, Patriot Environmental Services** provides a wide range of industrial, emergency response and remediation services. We are committed to the principles of safety, superior customer service and experience, and unyielding quality and dedication.



We provide a broad array of environmental services to meet any need that our clients may have. From emergency spill response to hazardous waste transportation to wastewater treatment, or from industrial cleaning to full facility closure and remediation, Patriot can do it all with our own internal resources and do so while accomplishing every metric of success.





**Our mission is to always be Prepared and Professional.**


**Join the team that makes a difference!**





**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Ensure that Health and Safety is the number one priority by complying with all safe work practices, policies, processes, and acting in a safe manner.
* Perform emergency response cleanup activities including but not limited to chemical and water spills, non\-hazardous and hazardous waste and toxic materials and equipment decontamination.
* Sweep, dig, shovel, lift, pressure wash and handling drums to assist in cleanup.
* Operate cleanup equipment used in hazardous waste activities.
* Follow policies and procedures for control and storage of hazardous substances.
* Attend safety training as required.
* Comply with the Random Drug Testing Program.
* Perform various housekeeping and custodial duties and other duties as required.
* Assist with maintenance of facility like unloading trucks and other ancillary duties.
* Answer 24/7 Emergency Response calls when on uncontrolled standby.
* Work long hours and overtime during day, night or weekend shifts.
* Other reasonable directives, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.


**EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND REQUIREMENTS**


* High school diploma or GED preferred.
* Some environmental services industry experience preferred.
* Some hazardous waste control experience preferred.
* Valid driver's license required.
* Driving record that meets company standards and current DMV printout, required.
* 40\-hour HAZWOPER certification required.
* Confined Space Entry certification preferred.


**SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES**


* Strong attention to detail; meticulous.
* Safety conscious.
* Patient
* Flexible to fast paced changes.


**PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS**


* Pushing / pulling: frequent daily basis
* Twisting / turning: frequent daily basis
* Lift items over head: frequent daily basis
* Standing: 6\-8 hours daily
* Crouching / stooping: prolonged periods
* Lifting / carrying: frequent daily up to 50 lbs
* Work in confined spaces or at heights.
* Required to wear a variety of personal protection equipment as required including but not limited to Tyvek suits.
* Required to wear respirators as needed.
* Performs labor intensive activities in all weather conditions during any hours during the day or night.


**BENEFITS**


* PTO, paid holidays, sick time
* Medical, dental, vision, life insurances
* 401(k) with company matching


Pay: $18 \- $25 per hourly





The compensation for the role will depend on several factors, including the candidate's qualifications, work experience, competencies, and skills, and may fall outside of the range shown.





**Patriot Environmental Services is an equal opportunity employer (EOE)**


**Check us out online at** **www.patriotenvironmental.com**

jobs.title: All Hazard Senior Environmental Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Description**
------------------------


Seattle City Light, a department of the City of Seattle, is one of the nation’s largest municipally owned utilities in terms of the number of customers served. Over the years we have worked very hard to keep Seattle's electricity affordable, reliable, and environmentally sound. Today, City Light is a recognized national leader in energy efficiency and environmental stewardship.


This position serves as Seattle City Light's primary technical resource for all\-hazards environmental risk analysis and program documentation, supporting the identification, assessment, and mitigation of climate\-driven risks to the utility's infrastructure and operations.


Under limited supervision, this position exercises independent professional judgment across a wide range of environmental and specialized scientific fields, including forestry, wildfire behavior, extreme wind events, and flooding. This position independently determines the scope of work, budget, schedule, and compliance requirements for environmental studies and consulting contracts, and is responsible for interpreting and applying environmental and wildfire\-related regulations to utility operations. This includes designing and overseeing environmental risk studies from an operational, all\-hazards perspective, and leading the update of related policies, programs, standard operating procedures, and guidelines.


The role sits within the Emergency Management team and works across Operations, Engineering, Asset Management, Vegetation Management, and external partners to ensure the utility has the data, analysis, and program documentation it needs to make informed risk reduction investments. This position will report to the Emergency Management Manager.


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


**All\-Hazards Risk Analysis and Mapping**

* Leads efforts related to all\-hazards environmental risk mapping, including scoping, vendor management, data coordination, and delivery of risk analysis products that inform capital investment and mitigation priorities.
* Commission and oversee risk studies and assessments conducted by external consultants, including wildfire risk mapping, infrastructure vulnerability analysis, and climate\-driven hazard modeling.
* Synthesize data from multiple sources, including LiDAR, GIS, outage history, vegetation treatment records, terrain, and weather data, into risk products that are actionable for engineers, operations staff, and executives.
* Evaluate emerging environmental risks, including wildfire, high wind events, flooding, and landslides, in the context of Seattle City Light's transmission and distribution infrastructure.


**Program Documentation and Compliance*** Develop and maintain technical documentation, progress reports, and program records for Seattle City Light's hazard mitigation programs, including the Wildfire Risk Reduction Strategy and any successor all\-hazards frameworks.
* Support compliance with state and federal regulatory requirements governing utility wildfire and hazard mitigation planning, including RCW 19\.29A.170 and RCW 76\.04\.185\.
* Prepare briefing materials, regulatory submittals, and City Council\-facing reports that communicate program status, risk posture, and mitigation progress to a range of technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Develop and maintain data tracking templates, dashboards, and reporting tools that support annual progress reporting and multi\-year program updates.


**Capital and Technology Project Support*** Review Seattle City Light's capital program portfolio and technology projects through an all\-hazards environmental risk lens, identifying gaps in risk reduction coverage and opportunities to integrate mitigation measures into planned work.
* Provide technical input on project scoping, prioritization, and sequencing to ensure that risk reduction objectives are reflected in capital planning decisions.
* Support integration of environmental risk considerations into asset management practices and long\-range infrastructure planning.
* Identify and pursue federal and state grant opportunities that support all\-hazards risk reduction.
* Maintain awareness of the evolving federal funding landscape related to utility resilience, climate adaptation, and wildfire mitigation.


**Cross\-Functional Coordination and Communication*** Represent all\-hazards risk reduction program requirements on cross\-functional teams and in coordination with Operations, Engineering, Asset Management, Environmental, and Emergency Management.
* Provide technical recommendations on vegetation management priorities based on environmental risk analysis and infrastructure vulnerability data.
* Coordinate data sharing and project inputs with internal teams and external partners, including vendors, consultants, state agencies, and tribal partners.
* Prepare and present technical findings, risk analyses, and program updates to leadership, regulators, and other stakeholders.

  

**Working Conditions**
This position is based at Seattle City Light's South Service Center and may require periodic field visits to transmission corridors, substations, and right\-of\-way areas. Some travel within Washington State may be required for agency meetings, field assessments, or regulatory engagements. This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain authorization for unsupervised access to critical cyber assets, critical bulk electric assets, and electric generating facilities, including successful completion of a background check.

  


**Qualifications**
------------------


**Minimum Qualifications**


Bachelor's degree in natural or physical sciences, environmental sciences, planning (with emphasis on environmental issues), public administration/policy (with emphasis on natural resources), or related field and a minimum of five years experience in environmental research, environmental law, impact analysis, environmental complianc

jobs.title: Client Data Management Specialist
jobs.description:
**At Adaptive, we're Powering the Age of Immune Medicine.** Our goal is to harness the power of the adaptive immune system to transform the way diseases are diagnosed and treated.



As an Adapter, you'll have the opportunity to make a difference in people's lives. With Adaptive, you'll create a career highlight through collaboration with bright, curious colleagues working at the apex of innovation and application.



It's time for your next chapter. Discover your story with Adaptive.

 **Position Overview**



The Client Data Management Specialist plays an important role within the Client Data Management (CDM) team and contributes to maximizing Adaptive's revenue through generation and delivery of clinical trial data for high\-value BioPharma customers using Adaptive's MRD assays.



The position works closely with internal stakeholders and BioPharma customers to establish study\-specific Data Transfer Agreements (DTAs) and to generate data of the highest quality as per the specifications of those documents, while meeting internal and external deadlines, keeping study documentation and data delivery methods up to date, and performing data updates.



The position is also responsible for assisting in the design, development, review and maintenance of software code to generate study\-specific customer data files and data analysis tools, and/or to provide project management support to the CDM team.



This role requires impeccable attention to detail, great communication skills, the ability to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to establish data\-related study requirements and troubleshoot issues, a good command of Adaptive's systems and processes, knowledge of molecular biology and/or high throughput analysis, and the ability to adapt to evolving priorities in a rapidly evolving landscape.

**Deliverable Generation**


* With assistance from the broader team as needed, collects study data and generates, reviews and delivers study files to customers as per study specifications, using multiple internal and external resources as needed in consultation with other CDM team members to deliver data timely and achieve the goals of Adaptive and clients.

Cross functional partners include Business Development (BD), Alliance Managers (AMs), Client Managers (CMs), Analytical Project Managers (APMs), and the Sample Management, Software and Computational Biology teams.
* In consultation with other team members, reviews customer data queries, and implements and verifies data cleanup activities as needed for reconciliation needs.
* Supports discussions with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial teams to align data workflows.
* Awareness of client data architecture and lifecycle management needs.

* Serves as main point of contact for DTA\-related discussions for assigned customers, including projects of low to medium complexity and scope.
* Participates in training and assists with DTA implementations.
* Monitors and maintains DTAs for assigned customers.
* Drafts and reviews low\-complexity DTAs that meet data needs for new and existing customers, participating in negotiations with customers, and finalizing them under supervision.

* Responds to client questions using general understanding of data and biological sciences

jobs.title: Air Quality Specialist/Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
**Pinyon is different…**  

…and we want unique individuals to come learn, grow, and thrive within our 32\-year employee\-owned company. Pinyon is a purpose\-driven firm that does work which matters in the communities we live; our employee\-owners are encouraged to drive their career paths towards their career goals; we want you to be the next team member to experience our welcoming culture where work is rewarding.
  

  

**Let us prove it!**  

If you're excited about this opportunity to contribute to a workplace that values diversity and fosters inclusivity, please apply, even if you think you do not fully meet the qualifications. Pinyon is a company of opportunity  

  

**About this Position**  

Pinyon is seeking an experienced Air Quality Specialist that can support several markets and projects that deal with air quality permitting and compliance for a variety of clients in the oil and gas, commercial/industrial, transportation, and local/federal government market sectors. The candidate will also have the opportunity to assist with noise analyses for similar clients.
  

  

**Responsibilities*** Task management including client interaction during air quality projects, and responsibility for oversight of high\-quality deliverables
* Development of air permit applications for federal and state agencies, including responsibility for strategy and quality review
* State and federal regulatory review, and application of those regulations to specific client situations
* Compliance recordkeeping and reporting based on permit conditions
* Greenhouse gas and state inventory reporting
* Assistance with delegation to entry\-level air quality personnel as part of task management responsibilities
* Support air quality proposal development and client marketing efforts as needed
* Transportation conformity analyses, including conducting evaluations per DOT and FHWA protocols

  

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities*** Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience)
* 4\-8 years in Air Quality\-related professional services; candidates with more or less relevant experience are encouraged to apply
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs
* Preferred experience with emissions and impacts models such as ProMax, AERMOD, and MOVES
* Experience and knowledge with federal or state regulations review
* Self\-driven with the ability to oversee and complete multiple projects simultaneously, requiring minimal supervision
* Critical thinker and problem solver that can work in a dynamic group environment
* Exceptional communication skills, particularly with technical writing
* Employment is contingent upon the results of a background check

  

**Application Process**  

To submit your resume and cover letter visit our careers page at https://pinyon\-env.net/careers/, select your desired position, click 'Apply Now' on the right, and complete the submission form. For any accommodation needs during the application process, please reach out to Employee Services via email at careers@pinyon\-env.com or by phone at 303\.980\.5200\.
  

**Application deadline:**Our team will review applications upon receipt and will schedule interviews with qualified candidates. The application acceptance will stay open until we have a strong pool of candidates, or until a candidate is chosen. We appreciate the time and effort you’ve put into your application and will give each submission careful consideration.  

**Summary of Benefits**  

Pinyon offers a comprehensive range of benefits including accrued vacation, sick, and paid holidays; 100% employer paid premiums for health insurance through United Health, 100% employer paid premiums for base dental and vison insurances through MetLife; long term disability; life insurance; ESOP and employer matching 401k. Pinyon also offers several bonus programs including an overtime bonus program, profit share program, and a spot bonus program.  

**EEO Statement** Pinyon is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age 40 and over, color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, military or veteran status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation or any other applicable status protected by state or local law.  

**About Pinyon**  

Pinyon was established in 1993 by Lauren Evans, PE, and she has grown Pinyon from a one\-woman outfit based out of her garage, to a thriving and growing environmental consulting firm. The firm now employs over 80 environmental professionals and support personnel and has expanded from its headquarters in Lakewood, Colorado (near Denver) to include branch offices in Loveland and Colorado Springs, Colorado, as well as a satellite office in Phoenix, Arizona. Pinyon is a client\-centric environmental consulting firm that works towards collaborative solutions to advance our clients’ needs while protecting environmental health and safety. Pinyon supports private and public sector projects for commercial and industrial, energy, public works, federal, and transportation clients. Given the depth and breadth of our technical team, we are the go\-to firm for permitting and compliance on the local level and looking to expand our NEPA qualifications across multiple market sectors. Pinyon is committed to continue to expand our portfolio of projects both in our current geographies and elsewhere in the United States.  

  

Equal Opportunity Employer – veterans, disability

jobs.description:
Description:  


Join Our Environmental Adventure!  


Are you ready to make a real impact on the environment while working with a supportive, energetic team? CMS—a national leader in environmental compliance and management—is looking for a passionate Environmental Analyst to join our team!  


At CMS, we blend science, integrity, and teamwork to protect and enhance our planet’s natural resources. You’ll be part of a growing company that values dependability, compassion, and doing what’s right, while offering the tools and training you need to succeed.

Inspect erosion and sediment control measures on commercial, residential, industrial, and highway construction projects.

Manage client accounts and collaborate daily with contractors, engineers, and regulatory contacts.

Requirements:  


What You’ll Bring  


Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Geology, Hydrology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).  
Strong technical and field skills, with a desire to pursue professional certifications such as CISEC or CPESC.  
Excellent written and verbal communication, organizational, and analytical skills.  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with environmental data systems.  
LEVEL 1 TDEC Certification is a plus (compensation adjusted accordingly).  
A commitment to integrity, accuracy, and environmental responsibility.  


Work Location: On the road

**The Opportunity:**


Tetra Tech is adding experienced Cost Estimators to our Disaster Recovery team to support current and future disaster recovery operations across the United States.

**Why Tetra Tech:**


At Tetra Tech, we are *Leading with Science* to solve the world's most complex challenges. Our industry\-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting\-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Our work leverages cutting\-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world\-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. **Position Summary:**


As a Cost Estimator in Tetra Tech's Disaster Recovery Cadre, you will support FEMA Public Assistance and other disaster recovery programs by developing accurate, defensible, and well\-documented cost estimates for infrastructure restoration, emergency work, and permanent work projects. You will evaluate damaged infrastructure, develop and validate project scopes, prepare cost estimates, and support funding eligibility determinations for public facilities and infrastructure.


This is an on\-call, as\-needed position supporting disaster recovery programs following hurricanes, floods, tornadoes, wildfires, earthquakes, and other federally declared disasters. Assignments may be remote, field\-based, or hybrid depending on client needs and project requirements.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Support FEMA Public Assistance and other disaster recovery programs through project scoping, damage assessment, and cost estimating activities.
* Support site inspections of damaged facilities and infrastructure to understand disaster\-related damages, proposed repairs, and construction requirements.
* Evaluate project scope, means and methods of construction, and restoration approaches.
* Assist with the development and validation of disaster recovery project scopes.
* Collaborate with applicants, engineers, architects, contractors, and program staff to define eligible work and project requirements.

**Cost Estimating**

* Prepare conceptual, parametric, and detailed bottom\-up cost estimates for disaster recovery projects.
* Develop labor, equipment, materials, subcontractor, and general conditions cost estimates.
* Estimate costs associated with repair, restoration, reconstruction, mitigation, and replacement projects.
* Prepare cost analyses for roads, bridges, utilities, buildings, drainage systems, parks, and other public infrastructure.
* Support development of FEMA Cost Estimating Format (CEF) analyses when required.
* Develop estimate documentation that is clear, defensible, and suitable for audit and program review purposes.

**Technical Review and Compliance**

* Review engineering reports, plans, specifications, contractor proposals, and construction cost documentation.
* Evaluate project assumptions, quantities, unit costs, and estimating methodologies.
* Apply knowledge of applicable construction standards, codes, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify cost drivers, scope changes, and factors impacting project eligibility and funding.
* Assist project teams with cost validation, reasonableness determinations, and documentation reviews.

* Provide technical estimating expertise to project managers, Public Assistance consultants, and applicant representatives.
* Participate in project formulation meetings and recovery planning discussions.
* Support Requests for Information (RFIs), technical reviews, appeals support, and other recovery program activities.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including engineers, architects, environmental specialists, grant professionals, and construction experts.
* Maintain project records and supporting documentation in accordance with client and program requirements.


**Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in construction estimating, engineering, architecture, construction management, infrastructure planning, or a related discipline.
* Experience developing conceptual, parametric, and detailed cost estimates for infrastructure or facility projects.
* Experience estimating labor, equipment, material, and construction costs.
* Familiarity with modern construction practices, facility assessments, project scope development, and construction inspection activities.
* Experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary project teams.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
* Ability to work independently and effectively under changing priorities and demanding schedules.
* Ability and willingness to travel as needed for field assignments.
* Valid driver's license.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Infrastructure Management, or a related field.
* Professional Engineer (PE), Registered Architect (RA), Licensed Contractor, Certified Cost Professional (CCP), Certified Cost Estimator, or similar professional credential.
* Experience using RSMeans, Xactimate, FEMA Cost Estimating Format (CEF), or other industry\-standard estimating platforms.
* Knowledge of FEMA Publ
